policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: Introducing O Presence
items.summary: O announced “O Presence,” positioning it as a new product offering. Watch for enterprise rollout signals and integration depth versus existing voice/agent features.

items.headline: GPT-5.6: Frontier intelligence that scales with your ambition
items.summary: O launched GPT-5.6 (Sol) and companion models (Terra, Luna), claiming improved intelligence/efficiency and broad availability across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

items.headline: G raises $650M to scale AI inference cloud
items.summary: G announced $650M growth capital, citing expansion toward ~200 MW by end-2027 and already operating 13 data centers. Implies continued capacity build and commercialization momentum.
